decisions.Kwic: 威音王者，形聲之外，未有出載，無所考據，文字以前最上事也。

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Sanfeng Cang (三峰藏和尚語錄), Five Schools Origin (五宗原), Linji School subsection (臨濟宗). Hanyue Fazang is the exact author and speaker who defines Mighty-Sound King as outside form and sound and as the highest matter before writing. The subsection heading names the school being discussed; it does not turn the prose into a saying by Linji Yixuan.
